tables.name: personal_text_previews
tables.owner_query: SELECT p.rowid AS rid,r.account_id,p.tenant_id FROM personal_text_previews p JOIN chat_runs r ON r.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND r.id=p.run_id
tables.key_transition: Preserve per-run broker binding and receipt. Fence restored and unknown calls against the installation ledger before any new dispatch.
tables.verification: Exact schema; row count; unique existing owner; declared FK integrity and cross-owner FK check
tables.on_failure: Stop dry run; quarantine unresolved ownership, never infer owner from email or table name.
